legacyOptions.query: select details from object_changes where $timeFilter AND dbname = '$dbname'
legacyOptions.rawQuery:
SELECT
  time,
  data->>'details' as text
FROM
  object_changes
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'

spec.description: use change_events metric for capturing table/index/sproc/postgresql.conf changes

spec.title: DDL / config change events
spec.description: If there are no vertical red stripes then no changes were detected for that time period

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $__interval),
  avg((data->>'load_5min')::float8) as "load_5min"
FROM
  cpu_load
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

select
  $__timeGroup(time, $__interval),
  avg( case when (xc = xc_lag and xr = xr_lag) then null else ( ((xr - xr_lag)::numeric*100) / ((xc - xc_lag) + (xr - xr_lag)) ) end ) as "Rollback ratio"
from (
  select
    (data->>'xact_rollback')::float8 as xr, lag((data->>'xact_rollback')::float8) over w as xr_lag,
    (data->>'xact_commit')::float8 as xc, lag((data->>'xact_rollback')::float8) over w as xc_lag,
    time
  from db_stats
    where dbname = '$dbname'
    and $__timeFilter(time)
  window w as (order by time)
) x
where xc >= xc_lag
group by 1
order by 1

SELECT
  (date_trunc('minute', time))::time as time,
  data->>'event' as event,
  tag_data->>'table' as table
FROM
  table_changes
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  (date_trunc('minute', time))::time as time,
  data->>'event' as event,
  tag_data->>'index' as index,
  data->>'table' as table
FROM
  index_changes
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  time::time,
  data->>'event' as event,
  tag_data->>'sproc' as sproc
FROM
  sproc_changes
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  time::time,
  tag_data->>'setting' as event,
  data->>'value' as value
FROM
  configuration_changes
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
ORDER BY
  time

SELECT
  (SELECT max(time) FROM settings_num
   WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time)) AS "Time",
  tag_data->>'name'       AS name,
  (data->>'value')::float8 AS value
FROM settings_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND time = (SELECT max(time) FROM settings_num
              WHERE dbname = '$dbname' AND $__timeFilter(time))
ORDER BY name

SELECT
  (date_trunc('minute', time))::time as time,
  tag_data->>'role' as role,
  data->>'event' as event,  
  data->>'privilege_type' as privilege_type
FROM
  privilege_changes
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
  AND (data->>'privilege_type' = 'LOGIN'
    OR data->>'privilege_type' = 'SUPERUSER') 
ORDER BY
  time, tag_data->>'role', data->>'privilege_type'

SELECT
  (date_trunc('minute', time))::time as time,
  tag_data->>'role' as role,
  data->>'event' as event,  
  data->>'privilege_type' as privilege_type,
  tag_data->>'object' as object
FROM
  privilege_changes
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
  AND data->>'privilege_type' != 'LOGIN'
  AND data->>'privilege_type' != 'SUPERUSER'
ORDER BY
  time, tag_data->>'role', data->>'privilege_type', data->>'object'
